task: 请为「零依赖 Rust 上下文压缩器」设计完整的模块架构（crate 内部结构）。这是一个对 LLM 上下文做 token 级重要性裁剪与结构行保护的库：输入任意文本（代码/文档/对话），输出压缩后文本，强调零外部依赖、逐字节可复现、可配置策略。请给出：1) crate/module 划分与每个模块的单一职责；2) 核心公共接口（struct/trait/函数签名级）；3) 数据流（从输入到输出的完整管线，标注每个阶段的输入输出）；4) 关键设计权衡（内存 vs 速度、确定性 vs 自适应、配置化 vs 简单）；5) 扩展点（新增裁剪策略/锚点类型/输出格式的接入方式）。输出必须是结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Design the internal architecture of a zero-dependency Rust library that performs token-level importance trimming and structural line protection on LLM context. Constraints: no external crates (std only); deterministic byte-identical output for identical input and config; configurable policy via CLI and policy files; supports code fences, markdown headings, numeric lines, and signature lines as structural anchors; graceful degradation on zero-signal input. Deliver: module tree with one-line responsibility each; public API surface (structs, traits, function signatures in Rust); end-to-end data flow diagram in text; 3-5 documented tradeoffs with the chosen side and why; extension points for new trim policies, anchor kinds, and output formats. Format: structured Markdown with clear section headings, bullet lists, and Rust signature blocks.
answer_spec: Markdown 输出：# 标题 + ## 章节（模块划分/接口/数据流/权衡/扩展点）+ 代码块承载 Rust 接口

task: 请为以下 Rust 热点函数给出完整的性能优化方案。函数：对一亿字符的 ASCII 字符串逐字符处理（大写转换），每次处理分配临时 Vec 并在循环内 push，总耗时 2.3 秒。要求：1) 先做瓶颈分析（指出主要开销来源：分配、分支、缓存、并行）；2) 给出分层优化方案（从零成本到激进），每层标注预期收益百分比与原理；3) 给出最终推荐方案的 Rust 实现要点（接口级即可，不必完整代码）；4) 分析每层优化的取舍（可读性、复杂度、适用边界）；5) 说明如何用基准测试验证（criterion 或手写计时器的设计要点）。输出必须是结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Provide a complete performance optimization plan for a Rust hot loop: processing 100M ASCII characters one by one (uppercase transform), allocating a temporary Vec and pushing per character, total 2.3s. Deliver: (1) bottleneck analysis ranking the dominant costs (allocation, branch misprediction, cache misses, lack of parallelism) with reasoning; (2) layered optimization tiers from zero-cost to aggressive, each with expected speedup and mechanism (e.g. preallocation, chunked processing, SIMD via std::simd or byte tricks, rayon or manual threads, unsafe buffer reuse); (3) Rust implementation outline at API level for the recommended tier; (4) tradeoffs per tier (readability, complexity, applicability limits, unsafe risk); (5) benchmark design to validate (criterion-style or hand-rolled timer: warmup, iteration count, statistical soundness). Format: structured Markdown.
answer_spec: Markdown 输出：# 标题 + ## 瓶颈分析/分层方案/推荐实现/取舍/验证 + 列表与代码块

task: 请设计一个 SGEMM（单精度矩阵乘法，M=N=K=4096）在 NVIDIA GPU（如 A100）上的 tiling 策略与 kernel 结构。要求：1) 说明 grid/block/thread 层次与 tile 尺寸选择依据（结合寄存器数、共享内存容量、SM 数量）；2) 描述共享内存加载流程与 bank conflict 规避方法；3) 说明寄存器缓存（register tiling）与计算流水（pipelining/双缓冲）；4) 分析算子在不同 K 维度下的边界处理；5) 给出理论带宽/算力上界计算与预期的实际利用率；6) 说明如何用 CUDA 事件或 ncu 验证。输出结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Design the tiling strategy and kernel structure for SGEMM (M=N=K=4096, fp32) on an NVIDIA GPU such as A100. Cover: (1) grid/block/thread hierarchy and tile size selection rationale tied to 255KB shared memory per SM, 64K registers, 108 SMs; (2) shared memory load flow and bank-conflict-free access patterns (padding, staged loads); (3) register tiling (e.g. 8x8 or 16x8 threads computing 4x4 each) and double-buffering pipeline; (4) edge handling for arbitrary K; (5) theoretical roofline (fp32 FMA peak ~19.5 TFLOPS, HBM ~2TB/s) and realistic utilization estimate; (6) verification via CUDA events or ncu metrics. Format: structured Markdown with hierarchy diagram in text and kernel skeleton.
answer_spec: Markdown：# 标题 + ## 层次设计/共享内存/流水/边界/上界/验证 + 数字与代码块

task: 请设计 LLM 推理框架的 KV cache 显存管理子系统。背景：多请求共享 GPU，每个请求的 KV cache 随生成增长，峰值显存有限，超限需驱逐/抢占。要求：1) 设计核心数据结构（分页式 block table 的 page 大小选择、逻辑 slot 与物理 block 映射）；2) 驱逐与抢占策略（LRU/打分、请求级抢占、prefix 复用），说明每种策略的取舍；3) 并发安全设计（多流推理下的锁粒度/无锁方案）；4) 碎片化与利用率分析（internal/external fragmentation）；5) 提供关键接口签名（Rust 风格）与状态机。输出结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Design the KV-cache memory management subsystem for an LLM inference framework. Context: multiple concurrent requests on shared GPU; per-request KV cache grows during generation; finite VRAM; on overflow the system must evict or preempt. Deliver: (1) core data structure: paged block table with page-size selection rationale (e.g. 16 tokens/page), mapping from logical slots to physical blocks, free-block list; (2) eviction and preemption policies (LRU vs scored, request-level preemption, prefix/radix-tree reuse) with tradeoffs; (3) concurrency design under multi-stream decoding: lock granularity, lock-free alternatives, synchronization points; (4) fragmentation and utilization analysis (internal vs external); (5) key Rust-style interface signatures and the cache lifecycle state machine. Format: structured Markdown.
answer_spec: Markdown：# 标题 + ## 数据结构/驱逐策略/并发/碎片/接口 + 代码块与状态机文本

task: 请设计一个 Rust 实现的 work-stealing 任务调度器。背景：CPU 密集型并行计算，任务有依赖（DAG），运行期动态生成子任务。要求：1) 设计线程池结构（worker 队列类型：双端队列 vs 单端，窃取方向）；2) 描述窃取算法（victim 选择、LIFO/FIFO 取舍、竞争处理）；3) 说明 DAG 依赖如何表达与调度（任务就绪队列、计数器）与背压策略；4) 分析公平性与饥饿风险（大任务 vs 小任务）；5) 给出核心 trait/struct 接口与关键算法伪代码；6) 说明与 rayon 的差异与适用场景。输出结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Design a work-stealing task scheduler in Rust for CPU-bound parallel computation with a dynamic DAG (tasks spawn subtasks at runtime). Deliver: (1) thread-pool structure: per-worker queue type (deque vs single-ended), stealing direction (bottom vs top); (2) stealing algorithm: victim selection (random vs round-robin), LIFO/FIFO tradeoffs (cache locality vs fairness), contention handling (CAS vs mutex, exponential backoff); (3) DAG dependency representation and scheduling: ready-set with atomic counters, eager vs lazy spawn, backpressure (bounded queues, suspension); (4) fairness and starvation analysis (large vs small tasks, thief-induced imbalance); (5) core trait/struct signatures and pseudocode for push/pop/steal; (6) contrast with rayon's design and when to prefer this custom scheduler. Format: structured Markdown.
answer_spec: Markdown：# 标题 + ## 结构/窃取算法/依赖调度/公平性/接口 + 伪代码块

task: 请设计一个面向高频小对象分配的内存分配器（Rust，用于缓存与中间缓冲）。背景：每秒百万级 32-512 字节分配，多线程，要求低延迟低碎片。要求：1) 设计 size-class 体系（对齐/分级/上舍入规则）与对应 free list；2) 说明线程本地缓存（thread cache）与全局池的交互与回收；3) 说明 bump arena 与 slab 的组合策略（大对象 vs 小对象分界）；4) 分析内碎片/外碎片/内存膨胀的量化关系；5) 给出关键接口与安全注意（unsafe 范围、对齐、double-free 防护）；6) 说明与系统 malloc 的取舍。输出结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Design a memory allocator in Rust for high-frequency small-object allocation (caches and intermediate buffers): millions of 32-512 byte allocations per second, multi-threaded, low latency and low fragmentation. Deliver: (1) size-class system: alignment rules, class sizing with upper rounding, power-of-two vs uniform spacing tradeoff; (2) per-thread cache interacting with a global pool: batch refill/return, migration on thread exit, NUMA notes; (3) bump-arena vs slab combination: threshold between small and large objects, fallback paths; (4) quantitative analysis of internal fragmentation, external fragmentation, and memory blowup (worst case per size class); (5) key interfaces and safety: scope of unsafe, alignment guarantees, double-free prevention, whether a guard against use-after-free is feasible; (6) tradeoffs vs system malloc (glibc/jemalloc). Format: structured Markdown.
answer_spec: Markdown：# 标题 + ## 分级体系/线程缓存/组合策略/碎片量化/接口安全 + 表格与代码块

task: 请评审以下 LRU cache 设计并给出系统性改进方案。设计：struct LruCache { map: HashMap<K, Node>, list: DoublyLinkedList }，get(key) 命中将节点移到链表头；put 超出容量时淘汰链表尾。问题背景：多线程并发读写、热点 key 抖动、恶意访问导致缓存颠簸。要求：1) 列出 5 个以上具体缺陷（含边界：容量 0、同一 key 重入、并发竞争）；2) 对每个缺陷给出修复方案（接口级）；3) 评价整体设计的扩展性（如加入 TTL/分片/命中率统计的代价）；4) 给出改进后的接口签名（Rust 风格）；5) 给出针对并发场景的测试要点。输出结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Review the following LRU cache design and propose a systematic improvement. Design: struct LruCache { map: HashMap<K, Node>, list: DoublyLinkedList }, get(key) moves the hit node to the list head; put evicts the list tail when over capacity. Context: concurrent multi-threaded access, hot-key thundering, adversarial access causing cache thrashing. Deliver: (1) at least 5 concrete defects including edge cases (capacity 0, same-key re-entry, concurrent races, iterator invalidation); (2) a fix per defect at interface level; (3) extensibility assessment (cost of adding TTL, sharding, hit-rate statistics); (4) improved Rust-style interface signatures; (5) testing strategy for the concurrent scenario (deterministic stress, property tests, race detection). Format: structured Markdown.
answer_spec: Markdown：# 标题 + ## 缺陷清单/修复/扩展性/新接口/测试 + 编号列表与代码块

task: 请设计一个零依赖 Rust 结构化日志库。要求：1) 设计日志级别与过滤体系（编译期/运行期过滤、按模块定向级别）；2) 设计异步写入路径（无锁队列/有界队列、批量落盘、丢失策略）；3) 设计结构化字段（key-value 附加、JSON 输出、时间戳精度）；4) 分析性能预算（每日志条目开销目标：纳秒级格式化、微秒级落盘）与降级路径；5) 给出核心接口（宏 + logger trait）与初始化/全局状态管理；6) 说明与 log/env_logger/tracing 的取舍。输出结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Design a zero-dependency structured logging library in Rust. Deliver: (1) level system and filtering: compile-time vs runtime filtering, per-module target levels, static dispatch vs dynamic; (2) asynchronous write path: lock-free bounded queue vs mutex, batch flush, loss policy on overflow (drop-oldest vs backpressure), background thread lifecycle; (3) structured fields: key-value pairs, JSON encoding, timestamp precision (ns vs us), span/context propagation; (4) performance budget: per-entry formatting in nanoseconds, flush in microseconds, and graceful degradation when the queue is saturated; (5) core interfaces: macros + Logger trait, global initialization and reconfiguration, per-thread context; (6) tradeoffs vs log/env_logger/tracing crates. Format: structured Markdown.
answer_spec: Markdown：# 标题 + ## 级别过滤/异步路径/结构化字段/性能预算/接口 + 代码块与数字

task: 请为「确定性文本压缩器」（输入文本+配置 → 压缩文本，逐字节可复现）设计完整测试金字塔。要求：1) 设计单元层（每层组件：分词/打分/保序/渲染 的测试要点与典型用例）；2) 设计属性测试（proptest 风格：不变式列表——幂等性、长度单调、锚点保留、逐字节确定性）；3) 设计 golden 测试（基线文件策略、漂移检测、多配置矩阵）；4) 设计评测层（与真实 LLM 集成评测的取舍：成本/随机性/回归门禁）；5) 给出覆盖率策略与 CI 门禁建议；6) 说明每个层级的失败信号与调试手段。输出结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Design a complete testing pyramid for a deterministic text compressor (input text + config -> compressed text, byte-identical reproducibility). Deliver: (1) unit layer: per-component test points and representative cases (tokenization, scoring, ordering preservation, rendering); (2) property tests (proptest-style invariants: idempotence, length monotonicity, anchor preservation, byte-identical determinism, config commutativity); (3) golden tests: baseline file policy, drift detection, multi-config matrix, update workflow; (4) eval layer: integration with a real LLM — cost, randomness, and regression-gate tradeoffs; (5) coverage strategy and CI gate suggestions (which layers block merges); (6) failure signals and debugging tooling per layer. Format: structured Markdown.
answer_spec: Markdown：# 标题 + ## 单元/属性/Golden/评测/门禁 + 不变式列表与矩阵表

task: 请设计 LLM 推理框架的连续批处理（continuous batching）调度子系统。背景：多请求并发生成，各自长度不同，完成即腾出 slot。要求：1) 设计迭代级调度循环（每步选择下一轮参与解码的请求集合）；2) 设计抢占策略（长请求 vs 短请求、显存超限时的 swap/驱逐）；3) 设计前缀复用（radix tree、公共 prefix 缓存）与预填充/解码分离；4) 分析吞吐与延迟的量化权衡（bubble、TTFT 分布）；5) 给出调度状态机与核心接口；6) 说明与 vLLM/SGLang 方案的差异与取舍。输出结构化 Markdown。
en_task: Design the continuous-batching scheduler for an LLM inference framework. Context: concurrent requests generating tokens at different rates; a request frees its slot when finished. Deliver: (1) iteration-level scheduling loop: per-step selection of the decode set, admission policy, preemption checkpoints; (2) preemption strategy: long vs short requests, swap vs recompute vs evict on VRAM pressure, priority handling; (3) prefix reuse: radix-tree shared prefix cache, prefill/decode disaggregation, cache-aware admission; (4) quantitative throughput-vs-latency analysis: bubble ratio, TTFT distribution, batch utilization vs 3000ms SLO; (5) scheduler state machine and core interfaces; (6) contrast with vLLM and SGLang scheduling approaches and when each wins. Format: structured Markdown.
answer_spec: Markdown：# 标题 + ## 调度循环/抢占/前缀复用/量化权衡/状态机 + 伪代码块与表格
